comparison.objective: Install a rack rail; record carries a carton whose untaped bottom must be continuously supported.
comparison.physical_skill: Regrasping and mechanically latching a long rail versus continuous bimanual underside support of a loaded container during transport.
comparison.success_condition: Installed rail retained by prongs and screws versus carton placed upright on a shelf with every can retained and grippers released.
comparison.reason: Bimanual support is shared, but one establishes mechanical attachment while the other prevents payload loss during transport.
